fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body: Kitchenette with cooking hob (instructions: howdens.fr). The microwave, kettle and coffee maker are in the entrance cupboard, opposite the kitchenette.
fields.amenities.2.title: Kitchen
fields.amenities.3.body: To get you started — coffee and tea (first night), 2 to 3 rolls of toilet paper. For your entire stay — sheets and towels, hair dryer. Tap water is safe to drink.
fields.amenities.3.title: What we provide
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.0: Did you press the padlock after entering your code? It validates the entry — without pressing it, the box won't open.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.1: The box unlocked, but did you pull to the side to open it? Unlocking doesn't open it automatically.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: After several wrong codes, the box goes into safety mode. Wait 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, then try again calmly.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.title: Having trouble opening the key box?
fields.arrival.steps.0.text: You arrive at 44 rue Roger Radisson, on the Fourvière hill — at the corner of rue Jaricot, facing the Hôtel Fourvière.
fields.arrival.steps.0.title: Finding the building
fields.arrival.steps.1.text: The glass door is usually open. If it's locked, press « On » then 123456 on the keypad to the right.
fields.arrival.steps.1.title: The building entrance
fields.arrival.steps.2.code_note: Your code · active until your departure
fields.arrival.steps.2.photo_caption: The key box, next to the studio door
fields.arrival.steps.2.text: It's fixed next to the studio door. Place your palm on the keypad to turn it on, enter your code, then press the padlock. Wait for the beep, then pull to the side to open the box and retrieve the key.
fields.arrival.steps.2.title: The key box
fields.arrival.steps.3.text: The key opens the door. Welcome to the Lodge ✨
fields.arrival.steps.3.title: You're here
fields.checkout_line: windows closed, key in the key box
fields.house_rules.0.text: The entrance is ground-level. Living area, kitchenette, bathroom and separate WC. 3 steps to access the bed.
fields.house_rules.0.title: Ground-floor apartment
fields.house_rules.1.text: Smoking is prohibited inside. A CO₂ detector triggers an alarm if moved — restoration costs up to €65.
fields.house_rules.1.title: Non-smoking accommodation
fields.house_rules.2.text: A decibel detector and camera monitor the hallway (no conversations are recorded).
fields.house_rules.2.title: No parties or gatherings
fields.house_rules.3.text: Please keep this in mind: some guests may have allergies.
fields.house_rules.3.title: No pets allowed
fields.house_rules.4.text: Residential building — thank you for being considerate to neighbours.
fields.house_rules.4.title: Quiet after 10 PM
fields.luggage.sub_arrival: Nannybag luggage storage at Part-Dieu · from €4.50/day
fields.luggage.sub_departure: Drop off your luggage and enjoy Lyon until your train · from €4.50/day
fields.parking.text.0: Drop-off zone: there's almost always space to unload on rue Roger Radisson, in front of the building.
fields.parking.text.1: Free: parking often available on rue Roger Radisson, rue Jaricot, rue du Cardinal Gerlier, Montée du Télégraphe and Place du 158e RI. Free on Sundays, public holidays and in August.
fields.parking.text.2: Private garage: available at 29 rue Roger Radisson (garage n°1 out of 4, door on street) for €10 per stay — ask us.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: The bar « Les Collections » and the bistro restaurant « Les Téléphones », just across the way.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: Shaded terrace and dining room with fireplace, 350 m away. Refined bistro cuisine.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Fine dining restaurant with panoramic views, 700 m away. The wine bar « Phosphore » and its tapas below.
fields.recos.food.4.desc: Authentic Lyonnais bouchon (traditional restaurant), rue du Bœuf in Old Town — about 1.2 km away, or by funicular.
fields.recos.food.5.desc: Large terrace in summer, fondue by the fireplace in winter, 650 m away.
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: Convenience store, 1 rue de la Favorite.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: Bread and pastries 550 m away, 12 rue de la Favorite.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Gallo-Roman museum and ancient theatres, very close by. Free access to the theatres.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: Crypt and panoramic views over all of Lyon, about 700 m away. Stunning views from the esplanade.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: Renaissance district listed as UNESCO heritage, about 1.1 km away via Montée du Gourguillon or funicular. Don't miss the traboules (covered passageways).
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: Bartholdi fountain and Town Hall, in the heart of the Presqu'île.
fields.recos.visit.4.desc: Spectacular architecture at the tip of the Presqu'île, varied exhibitions.
fields.recos.visit.5.desc: 5 km riverside stroll. Allow ~15-20 min to walk down from the hill (or funicular + metro D).
fields.transport.lines.0.text: Fourvière station (F2) 600 m away or Saint-Just (F1) 400 m away — direct access to Old Town and metro D.
fields.transport.lines.0.title: Funicular & Metro D
fields.transport.lines.1.text: Jaricot stop (line 90) just below; St Alexandre stop (55, C21) 700 m away → Perrache.
fields.transport.lines.1.title: Bus
fields.transport.lines.2.text: Perrache in 15 min (bus C21 or 55); Part-Dieu in 45 min (metro B then D + funicular).
fields.transport.lines.2.title: Train stations
fields.transport.lines.3.text: Rhônexpress to Vaulx-en-Velin La Soie, then metro A → Bellecour, metro D → Old Town and funicular. Uber or taxi possible, similar duration.
fields.transport.lines.3.title: Airport
